summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing of Noxeal. Backend: 34/34 pytest passing after fixing one bug (POST /api/articles/{slug}/comments was leaking Mongo ObjectId in response, causing 500). All new endpoints work: /api/tags, /api/articles?tag=, /api/articles/{slug}/related, /api/articles/{slug}/comments (GET/POST), /api/comments/{id} DELETE (admin-any / owner / 403 for stranger). Search now matches tags. Sitemap.xml and robots.txt FAIL via the public URL because they live at the root path and the kubernetes ingress only proxies /api/* to the backend — both work correctly when hit at localhost:8001. Frontend (visual + DOM): hero title updated, manifesto strip with 01/02/03 present, search-icon now sits LEFT of placeholder (paddingLeft 56px, no overlap), tag chips on Explorar with #ia preselectable via ?tag=ia, article page renders tag chips, 7 social-share testids + copy-link button, react-helmet-async OG title/desc/image inject correctly, page <title> updates per route, comments section with 'Inicia sesión' CTA when anonymous, admin comments display 'EDITOR' badge, related articles 'Sigue tirando del hilo' with 3 cards.

critical.issue: Routes defined at app root (not /api/*). Kubernetes ingress only proxies /api/* to backend:8001, so the public URL serves the React SPA's index.html instead. Backend logic itself is correct (verified against localhost:8001: returns valid XML and text with Sitemap line). Move them to /api/sitemap.xml and /api/robots.txt OR add ingress rewrite rules. Until fixed, search engines crawling the public host will not see the sitemap.

minor.issue: FIXED by tester — motor.insert_one mutates the dict to add a Mongo ObjectId in `_id`; returning the dict caused FastAPI's JSON encoder to raise 500. Added `doc.pop('_id', None)` before return.

Carryover from iteration 1: backend/.env FRONTEND_URL still points to old preview host (682955d6-...) but actual public host is trending-news-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Sitemap output uses the wrong absolute URLs.

integration_issues.issue: Carryover from iteration 1: AuthContext fires GET /api/auth/me on every page load and logs 401 noise to console for anonymous users. Should swallow silently.

action_items: Move /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt under /api/ prefix (e.g. /api/sitemap.xml, /api/robots.txt) so the kubernetes ingress proxies them to backend. Or update ingress to forward those two static paths to backend.
Update backend/.env FRONTEND_URL to the actual public host (https://trending-news-3.preview.emergentagent.com) so sitemap URLs are correct.
Suppress 401 console noise from AuthContext probing /api/auth/me when anonymous (carryover from iteration 1).
[Optional] Show logged-in user's email next to the Salir button in the header (carryover).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_comment leaked Mongo `_id` ObjectId in response — fixed by tester. Apply the same defensive pop pattern wherever a dict freshly inserted via motor is returned to the client.
Sitemap/robots routes should be under /api/* per the project's ingress contract (see ENVIRONMENT SETUP: only /api/* is routed to backend).
No rate limiting on /api/articles/{slug}/comments POST — comments can be spam-flooded by any authenticated user.
Comments soft-delete leaves the row in DB indefinitely; consider TTL or hard-delete-after-N-days.
server.py at ~600 lines is acceptable but starting to mix concerns (auth, articles, comments, SEO, CORS). Split into routers when adding more features.
Carryover: cookies set with secure=False; the preview is HTTPS so secure=True + samesite='none' would be more correct for cross-site scenarios.

Comments POST 500 was fixed by adding doc.pop('_id', None). Sitemap/robots failures are EXPECTED until main agent moves them under /api/ — when retesting after the fix, simply update the test URLs in test_sitemap_xml/test_robots_txt to BASE/api/sitemap.xml and BASE/api/robots.txt. rca of the issue: Comments POST 500 RCA: motor's AsyncIOMotorCollection.insert_one MUTATES the input dict, adding `_id: ObjectId(...)`. The handler then returned that same dict. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize bson.ObjectId, so it raised 'TypeError: ObjectId object is not iterable' (visible in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). Fix: pop `_id` before returning, or build a fresh response dict. Sitemap/robots RCA: kubernetes ingress is configured to only forward paths matching /api/* to the backend service on port 8001. Routes registered at the app root (not under api_router) are unreachable from the public host — the React dev server (or static index.html) is served instead, with content-type text/html. Mitigation: register them under /api or change the ingress.
